topic: Research Behavior Analysis - Competitive Evaluation Matrix

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We're conducting a comprehensive vendor evaluation for our 200+ store locations. I have a scoring matrix with weighted criteria for price, coverage, SLA terms, support quality, and POS system integration.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a thorough approach for a multi-location deployment. I'd be happy to provide detailed responses for each criterion in your matrix. Have you established weightings for each category?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: SLA and coverage are weighted highest at 30% each, support at 20%, integration 15%, and price 5%. We're more focused on operational reliability than cost savings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect alignment with our strengths. Our retail solution excels in SLA performance and coverage density. I'll prepare responses optimized for your weighted criteria and include retail-specific case studies.
